families.title: Seget, and Crete
families.statusNote: the flight of 1669 is tradition, well supported

cards.name: Giorgio de Franceschi
cards.title: Father of the two brothers who bought Seget. The family's Venetian form of his name, Zorzi, is the one on the War of Candia pension of 1730.

cards.name: Marc'Antonio de Franceschi
cards.title: Civil and military physician. Born 1671, two years after Candia fell — a child of the flight, not of the island. His wife's name is Chrysoula Marouli, Greek and not Istrian.

cards.name: Alvise de Franceschi
cards.title: Lived at Seget. The family genealogy records him as «Dragomanno alla Porta ottomana» — dragoman at the Ottoman court. Six children.

notConnected.why: This archive has argued from documents that the Seget house and the Gologorica house are two different families of one surname — Seget out of Candia in 1669 by way of Zante and Sebenico, with a Venetian war pension; Gologorica out of Carnia around 1700, artisans who bought land and were written down as «D.no».

cards.name: Pietro Franceschi
cards.title: The first generation the family's own historian could reach.

cards.name: Francesco Maria Franceschi
cards.title: Born Genoese; died French. Genoa ceded the island in 1768, when he was eighteen.

cards.name: Simone Franceschi
cards.title: Born at Ersa and dead at Ersa, eighty-one years apart. Married Caroline Mattei.

cards.name: François Marie Franceschi
cards.title: Went out through the French Caribbean and died at Miranda, in Carabobo.

notConnected.why: Six generations, twelve in-marrying Corsican families, and no contact of any kind with Istria, Carnia or Dalmatia.
